headline: On last trading day, Sensex plunged 1,484 points; markets closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian stock markets are closed today in observance of Guru Nanak Jayanti
The last session saw heavy selling pressure in the banking and metal sectors
Profit-taking occurred in financial stocks following a sustained four-week market rally
Sentiment was impacted by weak global market cues and falling US stock market futures
whatHappening: The Sensex dropped 1,484 points and the Nifty fell below 25,400 during the previous trading session
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) maintained a 16-session buying streak, investing ₹5,672.99 crore
India's AI funding nearly doubled to $1.6 billion in the first nine months of 2026
Investors have gained ₹34.61 trillion in wealth during November despite the recent market decline
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Guru Nanak Jayanti after a sharp 1,484-point decline in the Sensex during the last session. The drop was driven by profit-taking in financials and heavy selling in banking and metal stocks, despite continued buying by FIIs. Trading is set to resume on Wednesday, 25 November.
